as_told.title: Peter Thiel on Rogan: faster-than-light aliens must be angels or demons

plain: In 2024 the investor Peter Thiel went on The Joe Rogan Experience, the talk show hosted by Joe Rogan, and spent about half the conversation on aliens. Thiel argued there that if aliens are real, they must be something like angels or demons, and he cited the work of the religion scholar Diana Pasulka. Michels told Pasulka about it on his show in December 2024, saying it had happened a month earlier. In a later episode Thiel's reasoning is given in his own words, with no date and no mention of Pasulka: "If you have faster than light travel, there's something really crazy that has to be true on a cultural, political, social level."
